changed_file_contents.site/.github/workflows/docs-quality.yml:
name: Docs Quality

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  docs-quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: '10.28.2'

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Check formatting
        run: pnpm format:check

      - name: Lint Markdown
        run: pnpm lint:md

      - name: Build site
        run: pnpm build
